_meta.about: Every threshold and starting value of docs/ARCHITECTURE.md sections 5 and 6. Each leaf is {value, source}; source is the section number, 'estimate', or the API notes. D1 (Tue 10/27) and D6 (Sun 11/1) replace starting values; the plain values freeze into run.json and their sha256 is the config_hash on every sheet. Read with walkaround.contracts.load_thresholds().

proxy_fps.source: 16.2 (tracker confirms after 15 frames; E2 runs 15 then 10, 30 only if 15 fails)

image_only.source: 16.3 (image requests on door keyframes; one D1 video request for sigma_frame)

never_prompt.source: 2 Dropped; 5 step 5 (spatial phrasing is not honored)

voice_keywords.source: 5 step 11 (14 panel nouns plus 7 words, 21 under the cookbook's 50 cap)

topup_always.source: 5.4 (the car filter and the blur need them on the new clip)

car_box_containment_min.source: 5.1 item 1 (box area inside the largest car box)

off_car_tracks.source: R26 (11/2, hero_focus4: a door of the SUV parked behind the Focus passed the box test because that SUV stands inside the Focus's car box): a panel track is dropped before the vote when the median, over up to frames frames spread over it (frames on a grid of grid frames first, so tracks share one car decode), of the share of its mask pixels inside the car mask (the largest car box's object, as the keyframe mask test reads it) is under min_inside. On 14 stored runs the doors of the two cars beside the Focus (hero_focus1 to 4, 6 tracks each) measure 0.00, every other track 0.77 or more except thin slivers on the target car's own edge (an NHTSA windshield 0.35 and 0.46, a lexi rear bumper 0.36 and 0.38), which min_inside 0.25 keeps. Absent from runs frozen before it; the walk overlay applies the same measure to those as a display filter only

area_floor_small.source: 5.1 item 1 (side mirror, headlight, tail light, license plate, face)

border_frac_keyframe_max.source: 5.1 item 2 (over it counts for coverage, never a keyframe)

c_floor.source: 5.1 item 1 (no hard c floor anywhere before the merge)

anchor_pass_coverage_below.source: 5.1 item 6 (longest track under 70% of visible frames)

prompt_box_pad_px.source: 5 step 6 (padded to at least 2 px per side, clamped half-open)

direction_min_px_per_frame.source: 5.2 item 1 (|median| under 2 px per frame gives unknown)

keyframe_score_exponents.source: 5.3 (a plain product; exponents 1.0 are the weights)

fast_mask_decode.source: panels lane 11/1: walkaround/fastmask.py, the same rasters as meta_sam_parser bit for bit on every mask of pairC_core1's walk lanes, about 7x faster; false sends every keyframe mask to the DecodePool

keyframe_panels_in_flight.source: panels lane 11/1, estimate: panels scored, tested and blurred at once; each blur is 2 image requests, under orchestrator.sam_image_semaphore 16

door_glass_edge.source: lead 11/1, 2 m laps: a door box reaching the top of the frame is cut there by its glass, so the box pass leaves the top edge out of a door's border share; the mask pass measures completeness after the car windows are cut out (synth_pair2 offline: front doors G4 0.63 to 0.96 and 0.99)

fender_from_wheels.source: lead 11/1: SAM 3.1 has no noun for the panel over a wheel, so each wheel track gives a fender track (side from the wheel or the decided doors beside it) whose keyframe mask is the car mask near the wheel less every named part; sizes in wheel diameters d, estimates

view_match_return.source: lead 11/1: the return walk puts first the candidate whose whitened mask IoU with a pickup keyframe (same window cut, sharp enough for G3) beats the score order's best

twin_check.source: panels lane 11/1, measured offline on pairC_core1's stored lanes: plate on the lid in 84 to 96 of 92 to 96 plate frames on trunk lids and 0 of 65 to 71 on hoods; mirror 0.21 to 0.47 lid sizes from hoods and 2.6 from trunk lids; lights and glass placed by a lid were beside it on 97 to 100 percent of their frames, a mud flap the tail light lane tracked on 37 percent; margins and min_frames are estimates; absent (a run frozen before 11/1) means no check. margin_min 3 (review fix 11/1): one strong cue alone (plate or mirror) or the light and glass lanes alone, which swap themselves, no longer turn a walk's lid against its lane noun; that splits it instead (side uncertain, not compared). Every pair C lid decision scores 3 or 4 either way and is unchanged (pairC_core1's lanes, pairC_core2's tracks). photo_margin_min 2 keeps the claim photo's old rule, where Spark's own panel name must still agree

door_check.source: door check 11/1 (walkaround/docs/evidence/doors_1101/): after the side vote each car door track is judged from what the walk tracked. Side: lid_side, a hood or trunk lid the twin check decided, on shared frames (the hood is toward the front, the trunk lid toward the rear; dir_share_min of them one way); mirror_side, a side mirror outside the door box (gap >= mirror_side_gap_min door widths) on frames where the door box is not edge-on (aspect >= side_view_aspect_min). Position: mirror, the nearest mirror centroid in the door's height band (mirror_band_door_heights above it) at <= mirror_near door widths marks the front door, >= mirror_far the rear (median gap on stored runs: front 0.00 to 0.05, rear 0.54 to 2.18); wheel, a wheel box with >= wheel_overlap_min of its width under the door on >= wheel_rear_share_min of the frames with a wheel marks the rear door (rear 0.54 to 1.00 of frames, front 0.00 to 0.33; a door clear of the wheels says nothing, its wheel may be out of the frame); pair, a same-side door sharing frames (box IoU under same_door_iou_min) toward the front or rear; walk, which of two same-side doors the walk reaches first. A weighted sum reaching margin_min decides; under it the side vote's answer stands unless a cue points the other way, then the side or position is left undecided (side_uncertain). A door frame whose box holds >= end_light_inside_min of a headlight or tail light box is an end view (a tailgate or a corner; SAM's door lane on the NHTSA Golf's hatch) and never a door keyframe candidate. Each cue votes on >= min_frames frames (1 on a claim photo, where photo_margin_min applies). Estimates from pairC_core3, synth_pair2_r9, eval_nhtsa15759_r6 and eval_px_two_takes_r7. Off when absent, so runs frozen before it vote as before

uncertain_per_track.source: lexi run 1 (11/2, docs/LEXI_RUN1.md): side or position uncertainty is judged per track, not per slot. A panel is side_uncertain only when some walk holds nothing but undecided tracks in its slot; a stray undecided track beside decided ones takes no keyframe there (it never did) and is named in that slot's coverage line. On lexi_pair1 one undecided door track (return_car_door_08) and one undecided lid twin (return_hood_00 / return_trunk_lid_00) hid the left rear door and the hood although every keyframe of both came from decided tracks. Off when absent, so runs frozen before it keep their panels

wheel_order_after_side.source: R29 (hero_focus5b, Sanat's checks of 11/2): after the part check settles each wheel's side, side-decided wheels of one walk that share min_shared_frames or more frames with another wheel of the same side are re-filed front or rear by their order on the image (the car's front is to the left on its left side and to the right on its right side). The vote set a wheel's position under the side it voted; the part check could move it to the other side and keep the position, and R4 gives front to every wheel sharing frames with a headlight, so on hero_focus3, 4 and 5 both pickup left wheels (tracks 00 and 02 are the rear wheel, 01 the front) were left_front_wheel and no pickup keyframe or fender was ever made for left_rear_wheel or left_rear_fender. On pairC_r16 the return front right wheel was a second right_rear_wheel the same way. No other stored run changes. Absent from runs frozen before it

part_check.source: lexi run 1 (11/2, docs/LEXI_RUN1.md): after the door check, in its style, each wheel and fender-lane track is judged for its side (lid_side: a placed hood or trunk lid on shared frames, the front shows image-right on the right side; light_side: a placed headlight or tail light the same way; a lid or light votes on a frame only when its centre lies offset_min_d wheel sizes or more to one side, since the hood over a front wheel sits 0.0 to 0.33 wheel sizes off its centre on lexi_pair1 (depth, not direction) while lights sit about 1; door_side: doors with a decided side beside the wheel, the gap rule of fender_from_wheels with door_gap_d wheel diameters), each with dir_share_min of min_frames or more frames one way; and each windshield or rear-window track for its end (lights, bumper, lid: a placed part of one end beside the glass, box gap <= adjacent_sizes glass sizes, on presence_margin more of the glass frames than the other end's; mirror: a side mirror within mirror_near_sizes glass sizes on presence_margin of the frames marks the front, never the rear). A weighted sum reaching margin_min decides; under it the vote's slot stands unless a cue points the other way, then the side or end is left undecided (side_uncertain). Built fenders follow their wheel. Estimates from lexi_pair1's stored tracks. Off when absent, so runs frozen before it vote as before

edge_on_floor.source: edge-on floor 11/1 (walkaround/docs/evidence/doors_1101/): a keyframe candidate whose panel mask (after the window cut) is narrower than this width over height for its noun is seen near edge-on and never becomes a keyframe; a panel whose every scored candidate is under it keeps no keyframe and coverage says it was only seen edge-on. Stored keyframes looked at by eye: door slivers 0.21 to 0.36, the narrowest usable oblique door 0.42; an edge-on tire 0.32, oblique wheels with the rim readable 0.39 to 0.43; fenders all >= 0.78. Off when absent, so runs frozen before it pick keyframes as before

filmed_area_frac_min_by_panel.source: R27 (11/2, hero_focus4): both walks filmed the headlights whole and sharp (completeness 1.00, sharpness 0.88 to 1.00, crops 526 to 584 px wide) but at 0.017 to 0.022 of the frame, under filmed_area_frac_min 0.03, so the panel read glimpsed and G1 not comparable. Over the keyframes of every stored run that were complete and sharp, 79 of 101 headlight, 80 of 99 mirror and 88 of 105 tail light keyframes sat under 0.03; these floors keep the smallest views out (a 0.01 headlight is about 290 x 72 px on a 1080p frame). Absent from runs frozen before it

c_present_floor.source: 5.4 (C_PRESENT_FLOOR; below it the basis is area_only)

road_spray_min_marks.source: 5.6 (same type, horizontal band, bottom quarter of a door or bumper)

count_mode_new_point_min_units.source: 5.7 (farther than 0.1 units from every box-mode mark)

marks_on_panel.source: lexi run 1 (11/2, docs/LEXI_RUN1.md): a Spark mark counts on a panel only when its point lies on that keyframe's panel mask, within max(3 px, claim.on_panel_frac of the crop's long side), the claim path's rule and number. A mark off its panel is moved to a keyframe of the same walk cut from the same frame whose panel mask holds the point (box and point mapped through the source frame, whitened there); otherwise it is left out of matching and named in how_checked. On lexi_pair1 15 of 35 marks sat off their own mask, 14 by more than 0.025; dropping them alone took needs your eye from 10 lines to 3 with no correct line lost (docs/lexi_run1/replay_base_onpanel.txt). Off when absent, so runs frozen before it rebuild unchanged

sam_box_refine.source: box fix 11/1 (walkaround/docs/evidence/box_fix_1101/): each Spark box mark goes to SAM 3.1's image endpoint as a box prompt on its crop (pad_px a side; all of a crop's boxes in one request, at most max_objects); SAM's tight box replaces Spark's when the mask has at least min_mask_px pixels, covers at most max_crop_frac of the crop, does not just fill the prompt (its box inside the prompt box and at least fills_box_min of it, SAM segmenting blank paint), its box is at most max_area_ratio times Spark's box, and at least min_inside of it lies inside Spark's box grown by max(margin_px, margin_frac x its long side); else Spark's box stays and the mark says why. Estimates from 8 probe marks. Off when absent, so runs frozen before it rebuild unchanged

spark_zoom_refine.source: zoom refine 11/1 (walkaround/docs/evidence/zoom_refine_1101/): each Spark box mark gets one more marks_v1 call (same prompt sentences and effort, no landmarks) on a window around its box, short side max(min_px, window_patches patches, the box plus one patch a side), long side to out_w:out_h, shifted inside the crop, enlarged to out_w x out_h; the mark keeps Spark's box size and type, moved so its centre is the centre of the returned box nearest Spark's box centre, then shifted inside the crop; no returned box keeps Spark's box. Runs before sam_box_refine, so SAM is prompted with the moved box. On Sanat's 48 hand-moved boxes of pairC_core3: median IoU 0.149 to 0.353 (0.377 with SAM after), centre on his mark 23 to 34, median centre offset 26.3 to 11.0 crop px; the zoom's own box is about a quarter of his box, so its size is not used. One Spark call per box mark (about $0.005 each). Off when absent, so runs frozen before it rebuild unchanged. prefer_kind (11/2, hero_focus1: a scrape Spark boxed 15 px low went to a faint dash the zoom typed unsure, the nearer of 6 zoom boxes): when Spark typed damage, the nearest zoom box typed damage is taken when there is one, else the nearest box. On Sanat's hand boxes (docs/evidence/hero_1102/zoom_kind.json) it changes 1 of 48 pair C boxes (a win) and 0 of 41 synth boxes; absent means off

tau_pre_cap.source: 5.10 (above it the matcher is not calibrated)

pair_scale.source: R27 (11/2, hero_focus4): the return right rear wheel's mask held both wheels of that side, so its crop and the fender built from it spanned the whole side (long side of the box 1874 to 1914 px) against a close pickup crop (476 and 516 px). A keyframe's scale is the long side of its panel mask's box in source px (for a fender built from a wheel, the wheel box's long side at that frame); pairs within prefer_ratio are tried first, and a pair over max_ratio fails G11. On hero_focus4 every other panel's pairs sat within 1.15 except the roof (1.14 and 1.53). Absent from runs frozen before it

twin_mirror.source: R27 (11/2, hero_focus4): with the headlights counted as filmed, the pair chosen first set the pickup's left headlight against the return's right one (whitened mask IoU 0.91, so G4 passed). Each mask cut to its box and scaled to grid x grid: the same lamp overlapped 0.80 and 0.73 as it is (0.35, 0.34 mirrored), the other lamp 0.45 as it is and 0.91 mirrored; tail lights and mirrors of the same side 0.57 to 0.96 as they are. A headlights, tail lights or mirrors pair whose masks overlap better mirrored than as they are by more than margin fails G13 and the next keyframe pair is tried. Absent from runs frozen before it

privacy_blur.source: R27 (11/2, hero_focus4): the hood got already there from a pickup crop mostly under the privacy mosaic. A keyframe crop whose panel mask is more than view_max blurred for privacy fails G12 (another keyframe pair may pass), and a mark with more than mark_max of its box under the blur is left out of matching with a line in how_checked. Needs keyframes made under privacy.mask_blur (they record the blurred share and a blur mask); absent from runs frozen before it

sigma_spark.source: D1 E6 re-run on real marks at effort low, 5 calls per crop (runs/d1/uco3d_pairC/spark_redo/gate_spark.json): uCO3D pair C trunk chips 0.073 and 0.090 units, uCO3D Alto hood dent 0.117; the largest is kept. With it match.calibrate gives tau_pre0 0.4 (the cap) and tau_eye 0.8, the band lead note 3 on docs/evidence/D1_MEMO.md keeps. sigma_frame stays absent: E8's door-handle 0.11 to 0.17 would print a Stays Put tau_fix of 0.507, which note 2 refuses

tight_pair_second_look.source: lead decision 11/1, rule 1: on a pair inside tau_pre_r (L3) K4 (type dirt, reflection or unsure) and K12 (Spark confidence low) are notes, not caps, and the pair goes to the second look (Spark Open on the hackathon key, then the account key, then hosted Muse Spark 1.3), which may lower it (K7); with no usable answer (not asked, or every engine failed) they cap as before. Marks seen in one walk only and pairs in the band keep them as caps. An already-there call rests on geometry, the same spot in both walks, not on what the mark is; the second look compares the two crops and is the veto; without it, stay conservative. Absent (runs frozen before 11/1): K4 and K12 cap every pair

second_marks_pass.source: lexi run 1 (11/2, docs/LEXI_RUN1.md): on a panel that passed every gate with no mark in one walk and marks in the other, Muse Spark is asked again (marks_v1, the run's sentences and effort) on that walk's compared crop, on the zoom refine's window (dedup.spark_zoom_refine, needed) around where the other walk's mark maps through the panel frame; the returned box nearest that spot becomes a mark with Spark's type and confidence and the usual caps, and the match decides. At most max_asks calls per run, surest other-walk marks first; about $0.0065 a call. Wheels are left out. on_panel (added after lexi_pair2, where a second-pass box 3.3% of the crop's long side off the rear-window mask paired as already there): with dedup.marks_on_panel on, a returned box whose centre is off the keyframe's panel mask is not used. Stored in second_pass.json and replayed by rebuild. Off when absent, so runs frozen before it rebuild unchanged

next_keyframe_pair.source: lead decision 11/1, rule 2: when a panel's chosen keyframe pair fails a view gate (G3, G4, G5, G8, G9), match tries the panel's other keyframe pairs (clean views first as prefer_clean picks them, then the product of the two keyframe scores, highest first, ties by keyframe index) and compares on the first that passes every gate; G1, G6, G7 and G10 stay panel-level. Each pair tried is recorded with its gates (matches.json kf_pairs_tried, the sheet's how-checked line). Absent (runs frozen before 11/1): one pair per panel

tight_pair_k5.source: lead decision 11/1 (second): with tight_pair_second_look on, K5 (the two marks typed as incompatible kinds) joins K4 and K12 on a pair inside tau_pre_r: a note once the second look answered, not a cap by itself, so the pair goes to the look (Spark Open first), which may lower it (K7); with no usable answer K5 caps as before. Walks and claims alike. Absent (runs frozen before this leaf, pairC_core3 among them): K5 caps a tight pair by itself

reshaped_panel.source: lead decision 11/1 (second): when G4 is the only failing gate on every keyframe pair tried and the best whitened mask IoU is in [reshape_iou_min, mask_iou_min), the panel is needs your eye (L7, outline changed in place) instead of not comparable, only if the best pair's two keyframe box aspect ratios agree within reshape_aspect_tol and, after a reshape_open_px opening, the largest blob of the whitened mask difference holds at least reshape_blob_share_min of it. A turned camera changes the aspect and spreads the difference along the outline; a crushed panel keeps the aspect and concentrates it. Never already there or new. Measured on one reshaped case (NHTSA 15759 left rear door: 0.4%, 64%) and seven viewpoint failures (each fails one test): estimates. Absent (runs frozen before this leaf): not comparable as before

reshape_iou_min.source: lead decision 11/1 (second), reshaped_panel: below it the outlines differ too much to call it the same panel reshaped

reshape_aspect_tol.source: lead decision 11/1 (second), reshaped_panel: |a - b| / max(a, b) of the two keyframe box aspect ratios

reshape_open_px.source: lead decision 11/1 (second), reshaped_panel: square opening on the whitened mask difference, removes the thin rim a small misregistration leaves

reshape_blob_share_min.source: lead decision 11/1 (second), reshaped_panel: the largest connected blob's share of the opened difference

one_walk_counter_look.source: lead decision 11/1 (third): a mark seen in one walk only (L1, L2, either mark of an L5 pair) whose label is new_or_unseen or not_seen_at_return with no cap goes to the second look with two outlined images, the mark's crop in its own walk and the other walk's crop of the same panel with the spot outlined (mapped through the whitened panel frame of the pair compared on, the handle residual undone; the box covers tau_pre_r around it). Same or unsure caps it at needs your eye (K16, the other walk may show it); different or no usable answer keeps the label. Same engine order as every look. Found on eval_px_two_takes: a parking-sensor dot Spark found in the return walk only came out new_or_unseen

counter_looks_max.source: lead decision 11/1 (third): at most this many counter-looks per run, Muse Spark's confidence on the mark highest first; the rest keep their label with a note

counter_confirms_mark.source: lead decision 5 of 11/1: new needs a confirmed mark. With one_walk_counter_look on, the counter-look asks two questions in one look: is there a damage mark (scratch, scuff, chip, dent, crack) inside the outlined box on the mark's own crop, and does the other walk's crop show the same mark at the outlined spot, each yes, no or unsure. Only yes and no keeps new_or_unseen or not_seen_at_return; part 2 yes or unsure is K16, part 1 no or unsure is K17; no usable answer keeps the label

seams_not_marks.source: lead 11/1: spark_client.SEAMS_SENTENCE in the marks prompt. Tested on all 50 stored synth_pair2 crops, 2 answers per prompt (docs/evidence/seams_1101): false boxes 83 to 74, boxes on a ground-truth mark 5 to 3. Not adopted: the cut is small and the true finds fell

fixtures_not_damage.source: lead decision 4 of 11/1: factory fixtures are not damage. A mark whose box sits on a fixture the run already has (a fixture landmark Muse Spark pointed at in the same crop, or the SAM door-handle point of its keyframe) by at least fixture_overlap_min of its box is left out of matching and named in how_checked; and the marks_v1 prompt asks Spark not to box factory fixtures. Off when absent, so runs frozen before it rebuild unchanged

fixture_overlap_min.source: lead decision 4 of 11/1: the share of the mark's box inside the fixture's box at or above which the mark is a fixture (estimate; a mark that only touches a fixture stays)

fixture_half_grid.source: lead decision 4 of 11/1: the fixture landmarks and the half width and half height of each fixture's box around its point, on Spark's 0 to 1000 grid of the crop (estimates from typical part sizes on a door, bumper, hood or wheel crop; not measured). The SAM door-handle point uses handle

registration.source: registration (11/2, walkaround/register.py, match.registration_step; R21 in docs/BUILD_STATUS.md, evidence walkaround/docs/evidence/registration_1102/): on a compared panel the pickup crop is mapped onto the return crop (ECC on the two SAM masks, affine and homography, then SIFT matches on the outline band and rigid structure gated by that fit and fitted by RANSAC); refused under mask IoU 0.90 after an outline fit or 0.85 after a feature fit. Each mark's box is tested at its mapped spot (high-passed Lab patch search over the window between the two outline fits, then the box's saliency kept or lost): present caps a one-walk mark at needs your eye (K18) or pairs it with an unmatched mark there; a moment pair whose spots coincide is measured there. Other numbers are register.DEFAULTS. Offline on 7 stored runs: on true boxes 0 wrong calls (synth 80/100 old views present, 12/12 new views absent; lexi M2 4/4 present, M6 1/2 absent); verdicts: one false not seen at return removed (synth_pair2_r8), no new false new or already there; about 3 s a run, no model call

glass_by_eye.source: lead decision 11/2 (hero_focus1: 11 of 37 needs-your-eye lines were tree reflections and leaves on the windshield and rear window): glass panels get one line, 'glass: check by eye; reflections make marks on glass unreliable'; their marks are left out of matching and kept on the line (match.glass_by_eye). Side windows sit inside door crops whose masks cut the window out, so the on-panel rule already leaves those boxes out. evidence walkaround/docs/evidence/hero_1102/NOTES.md; R22 in docs/BUILD_STATUS.md

wheels_by_eye.source: R30 (lead decision of Nov 3, Sanat: car body only): the wheels (rims and tires) get no mark-level verdicts; like glass each gets one line, 'wheels: check by eye; rims and tires are not checked mark by mark', its marks left out of matching and kept on the line (match.wheels_by_eye). Wheel tracking, keyframes and crops stay, since the fenders are built from the wheels. On hero_focus5 the wheel lines were a rim glint at needs your eye and one already there (L8) on a turning rim; R30 in docs/BUILD_STATUS.md

debris_by_eye.source: R28 (lead decision 2 of 11/2, hero_focus5 rows 16, 17 and 23): any_view folds a mark seen in one walk only that Muse Spark typed dirt into the line whether or not its views are flagged (leaves in the trunk seam and a tail light speck on clean views); a mark with a damage type or unsure never folds. Absent from runs frozen before it. Before R28: lead decision 11/2 (hero_focus1: 8 of the front bumper's 9 needs-your-eye lines were leaves and specks typed dirt on views Spark flagged dirty): on a compared panel the needs-your-eye lines whose every mark is typed dirt and whose views (the ones K15 reads) are flagged fold into one line per panel, 'debris on this panel; check by eye' (match.debris_split); a line holding a damage type or unsure stays. evidence walkaround/docs/evidence/hero_1102/NOTES.md; R22 in docs/BUILD_STATUS.md

colour_on_paint.source: 11/2 (hero_focus1: the marks prompt names scratch, scuff, chip, dent and crack only, and Spark boxed none of the 4 pickup tape strips; paint transfer from another car looks the same and is a common rental charge): spark_client.COLOUR_SENTENCE asks for a stripe or patch of a clearly different colour on the paint, typed scuff, and the two-question counter-look counts one in part 1. Measured by asking the marks call again on the stored crops of four runs (docs/evidence/hero_1102/reask.py). evidence walkaround/docs/evidence/hero_1102/NOTES.md; R22 in docs/BUILD_STATUS.md

conditions_on_panel.source: 11/2: the marks prompt asks for the wet, dirty, glare and dark flags of the named panel itself, not of the whole crop, since K15 caps that panel's one-walk marks on them (a door crop with leaves on the windshield in it was flagged dirty). Measured on the same re-asked crops. evidence walkaround/docs/evidence/hero_1102/NOTES.md; R22 in docs/BUILD_STATUS.md

inside_other_box.source: 11/2 (K19): a mark seen in one walk only whose whitened box, in the frame the match compares in, lies at least half inside the whitened box of a mark the other walk has in its compared keyframe (match.COVERED_SHARE_MIN) is capped at needs your eye; the other walk did not show clean paint there. On eval_nhtsa15759_r16 with the colour sentence the return answer boxed the whole crushed door as one mark, and four pickup tape stripes under it came out not seen at return (match.covered_by_other_walk). The share, not the centre: with a centre test the crush's own new line was capped by a thin pickup tape box under its centre. Evidence walkaround/docs/evidence/hero_1102/NOTES.md; R22 in docs/BUILD_STATUS.md

same_walk_register.source: 11/2: on a compared non-wheel panel, each walk's marks of its other keyframes are carried onto the walk's compared keyframe by a registration fit of the two crops (register.align with the matching.registration numbers); a carried box landing on a mark already there (inside it or within register.coincide_px) is that mark seen again and leaves matching, any other is re-placed and whitened in the compared keyframe (match.same_walk_step). On hero_focus1 with the colour sentence one tape strip sat 0.4 to 0.9 panel units apart in the three pickup rear bumper keyframes (their SAM masks changed shape), over the 0.2 merge radius, so its copies stayed apart and none paired. Evidence walkaround/docs/evidence/hero_1102/NOTES.md; R22 in docs/BUILD_STATUS.md

stands_out.source: lead decision 11/2 (K20): a mark seen in one walk only must stand out from its own surroundings in plain pixels to be called new or not seen at return: register.own_contrast on its own crop and box (the registration presence test's contrast, the box's 90th percentile on the high-passed Lab residual over the ring's median, in ring spreads), under min_contrast (register.DEFAULTS saliency_min) caps it at needs your eye. A box over max_panel_share of its keyframe's panel mask is an area and is not tested: the NHTSA crush box covers 0.53 to 0.68 of its door and stands out by 0.9 to 1.4, as no local measure can for a box that is most of the panel. On hero_focus2 a stray pickup box on clean rear bumper paint (0.95) came out not seen at return; every hero tape strip stands out by 10 to 28. Replays: walkaround/docs/evidence/stands_out_1102/; R23 in docs/BUILD_STATUS.md

same_walk_copies.source: R28 (lead decision 1 of 11/2, hero_focus5 rows 14 and 15): after the verdicts, a mark seen in one walk only on another keyframe of the same panel and walk that maps onto a mark of a pair labelled one of into_labels is that mark seen again; it is merged into the pair with no line of its own and named in how checked (match.copies_step). It maps through the panel frame (whitened distance within dedup.cluster_radius_units) or the registration (register.align of its crop onto the pair mark's crop, same walk or the other walk; the box centre inside the pair mark's box or within register.coincide_px). A fit refused only after an outline fit (mask IoU after the warp at least refused_fit_min_mask_iou) counts when it puts at least refused_fit_min_hits of that keyframe's marks on distinct decided marks. On hero_focus5 the pickup rear bumper kf2 to kf1 outline fit was refused (mask IoU 0.87) and put both strips inside the strips' own kf1 boxes. Only removes lines; the counter-look asks are made before it, so stored looks replay unchanged. Absent from runs frozen before it

faint_left_off.source: R28 (lead decision 3 of 11/2, hero_focus5 row 19): a mark seen in one walk only that fails the stand-out test (K20, matching.stands_out) is left off the renter's list (no verdict line) and kept in how checked with its contrast (match.faint_step). geometric_already_there.source: R29 (lead decision 1 of 11/2 night, hero_focus5b mirrors_v1): a mark seen in one walk only whose patch the registration presence test finds at its mapped spot, with no mark of the other walk there, on a strong crop fit (accepted; the map sure within max_uncertainty_px at the mark; fitted on matched edges with min_inliers agreeing points spread over min_spread of the panel, reprojection at most max_reproj_px and mask IoU after the warp at least min_mask_iou, or on the outline alone with mask IoU at least outline_min_mask_iou) is labelled already there by code (L8) instead of capped at needs your eye (K18). The caps in caps_ignored only doubt the box is a damage mark, which matters for new or gone and not for a patch in both crops, so they do not lower it; nor does K15. A mark typed one of types_excluded stays capped (K18), so dirt seen in both walks folds into the debris line as before (on hero_focus5 six leaves on the hood, which Sanat labelled not a mark, would otherwise each get an already there line). With wheels true a compared wheel gets the same test (registration skips wheels otherwise), on a fit of matched edges only, since a rim turns between walks and the outline cannot say how far (hero_focus5b right rear wheel: 110 of 136 points over 0.48, 0.9 px, IoU 0.98, the rim mark present at NCC 0.95); on a wheel it only adds already there, no cap and no pair. Each such mark gets one look at the found spot after the counter-looks, on its own budget of looks_max; different or unsure lowers it (K7). The fits on hero_focus5b: left front door edges 24 points over 0.36, 1.2 px, IoU 0.91; right rear door 44 over 0.41, 0.8 px, IoU 0.98; mirrors outline IoU 0.97, 3.1 px at the mark. Absent from runs frozen before it

glimpsed_compare.source: R29 (lead decision 2 of 11/2 night): G1 no longer needs the panel filmed in both walks; a keyframe in each walk is enough and the view gates (G3, G4 or its registration vouch, G5, G9, and the rest) decide. On a pair compared though a walk only glimpsed the panel, a mark seen in one walk only keeps new or not seen at return only when its spot, carried by the accepted crop fit or else the panel frame into the other walk's keyframe, lies on that keyframe's panel mask; else needs your eye (K21). Absent from runs frozen before it

side_from_track.source: R28 (lead decision 4 of 11/2, hero_focus5 row 24): panels with no front or back orientation (the mirrors, front_sign null) are exempt from G6's front-sign test. Each keyframe's side comes from its own mirror track: the side of the side-decided door tracks it shares frames with, when that side holds at least min_share of those frames and at least min_shared_frames; a right mirror whitens as a right side panel (front_sign +1), a left one as a left side panel (-1). A keyframe whose track gets no side keeps G6; a pair whose two keyframes got different sides fails G13. On hero_focus5 both mirror tracks 01 share 455 and 234 frames with the right doors and none with a left door. Absent from runs frozen before it

registration_vouches.source: lead decision 1 of 11/2 (hero_focus3: the pickup walk's one rear bumper keyframe had its SAM mask cut short, whitened mask IoU 0.67 under G4's 0.70, and both strip pairs went not comparable): when no keyframe pair of a panel passes every gate, a tried pair whose only failing gate is G4, on a measured IoU with the frames agreeing, may pass G4 on the registration of the pickup crop onto the return crop (register.align with the matching.registration numbers): the fit must be accepted, fitted on matched edges (not the outline alone, which rests on the two masks G4 doubts), with at least min_inliers agreeing points spanning min_spread of the panel's box, a median reprojection of at most max_reproj_px and a mask IoU after the warp of at least min_fit_iou (match.vouch_check). A weak or refused fit leaves G4 as is and is recorded on the try. evidence walkaround/docs/evidence/vouch_majority_1102/NOTES.md; R24 in docs/BUILD_STATUS.md

look_majority.source: lead decision 2 of 11/2 (hero_focus2 and hero_focus3, the same footage: Spark Open's two-question counter-look saw damage in the new right rear door strip's box once and said no once (K17), and the label followed the one answer): the counter-look's mark confirmation (K17, and K16 from the same answers) and the pair look (K7) are asked up to asks_max times, stopping once agree answers take the same side of each yes-or-no part, and the label follows the majority (match.majority_pair_look, match.majority_counter): same keeps a pair and (yes, different) keeps a one-walk mark only when that side outnumbers the rest; a split is unsure, so a model still only lowers. An ask with no usable answer ends the asking and the answers before it stand. Every answer is its own looks.json row (ask 1 and 2 on the repeats); rebuild replays them in order. One-question counter rows are asked once. evidence walkaround/docs/evidence/vouch_majority_1102/NOTES.md; R24 in docs/BUILD_STATUS.md
